messages:
morgan: PR #19999 ready for merge from my side. pinging for 2nd approval — CI failing only on integration-e2e (shard-4). suspect a flaky. link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/19999
ben: saw the failure. looks like e2e/cart-checkout times out on the last step. snippet from logs:
```
TimeoutError: Element not found: selector="#checkout-button"
at tests/e2e/cart.spec.ts:152
```
zeynep: @ci-bot can you kick a targeted rerun for just the integration-e2e step on shard-4? would prefer not to rerun full matrix.
ci-bot: Re-run requested by zeynep. Targeted rerun queued for job 19999:integration-e2e:shard-4. Note: targeted reruns consume quota.
morgan: thanks — if it flakes again we can either update the snapshot or add a flake marker, but I'd prefer a clean pass first.
alice: I can approve once we have a green targeted run (or two green runs). if it keeps failing we should open a tiny follow-up to stabilize the test.
ben: quick local repro is intermittent (~1/10). adding `--retry` hides the symptom; I'd rather avoid masking it. can we capture a full Playwright trace if it fails?
zeynep: good call. if it flakes again I'll enable trace on that shard for the rerun: `PLAYWRIGHT_TRACE=on`. also adding a small wait before clicking might make the test consistent.
morgan: kicking targeted rerun now: `/bk retry --job integration-e2e --shard 4`
ci-bot: Targeted rerun started (job id: 12345). I'll post status updates here.
ci-bot: Targeted rerun finished: integration-e2e (shard-4) — PASSED ✅. artifacts: https://buildkite.com/artifacts/12345
alice: approving now :white_check_mark: morgan — you can merge after artifacts upload completes.
ben: merging once artifact checksum appears. if it resurfaces we'll open PR 20001 to stabilize the e2e.
morgan: thanks all. opened follow-up issue #20001 to add trace-on-failure and investigate root cause.
thread_text: PR #19999 ready for merge; intermittent e2e failure on shard-4, targeted rerun and approval flow recorded
